newsitem.title: GERMANY: Environmentalists fail to floor Berlin Love Parade.
newsitem.headline: Environmentalists fail to floor Berlin Love Parade.

text.p: A Berlin court on Tuesday threw out a complaint by environmentalists who said that a huge street party next month would damage a historic park in the centre of the German capital.

More than a million young people from around the world are expected to crowd into Berlin on July 12 for the eighth annual "Love Parade", a six km (four mile) long "rave" of techno music, dancing, outrageous behaviour and outlawed substances.

The BUND environmental group had asked for an injunction to keep the ravers out of the Tiergarten park next to the parade route, saying they would trample the plants and pollute the park with litter and excrement.
But the court said BUND was not a legal entity and had no right to make such a complaint. Relieved city authorities said nothing could stop the non-stop party now.
